mentions.name: openmakersuite
mentions.description: Open-source ERP system for makerspaces and community shared systems. It began as a kanban-style tool where members could request re-orders of supplies like cleaning products, and has evolved into asset tagging and asset maintenance, with ESP32-based device control in development to enable/disable devices via QR codes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Open Source ERP system for Makerspaces and Community shared system.

Started out as a kanban style of system where anyone could request that we re-order cleaning supplies at a Makerspace.  Has evolved to tagging assets and maintaining those assets and I'm working on adding ESP32 based device control to enable/disable devices through those QR codes.

https://github.com/uid0/openmakersuite
